data.title: 八奈见杏菜 · 食堂花束里的花嫁定食
data.description: 杏菜穿着清爽的蓝白婚纱坐在长桌边，捧花里偷偷插着一枚苹果糖；她先确认仪式菜单够不够丰盛，再对镜头举起苹果糖，笑得像终于等到一场不会落空的约会。
data.location: small school dining hall dressed for a ceremony
data.action: 长桌边先核对庆典菜单再举起花束中的苹果糖，笑得像等到不会落空的约会
data.lighting: warm afternoon light over blue-white decorations
data.camera: cowboy shot, vertical framing, bouquet and table visible
data.mood: 把失恋体质暂时换成花嫁满足感
data.promptProse: Yanami lifts the candy apple toward the viewer with a bright smile, her bouquet resting in the crook of her other arm. The checked ceremony menu lies on the long table among the blue-and-white afternoon decorations.
data.animaCaption: Her bouquet rests in her opposite arm beside the checked ceremony menu.
